Status: authoritative implementation plan and repository status entrypoint Milestone: Production v0.0 Last synchronized: 2026-08-09

This document is the documentation entrypoint for the Production v0.0 plan. The complete normative plan is maintained at the repository root in pakperk_production_v0_0_implementation_plan.md. That file is intentionally the canonical copy so agents working from the repository root and contributors reading docs/ use the same requirements. Changes to either location must preserve this relationship; do not summarize, silently narrow, or selectively supersede requirements from the canonical plan.

The current repository-versus-release evidence status is maintained in the Production v0.0 completion audit. Day-to-day commands and release sequencing are in the developer guide; the behavior exposed to readers is in the user guide.

What the plan governs

Production v0.0 evolves the existing modular Rust monolith and Flutter reader into a store-ready early product. It preserves guest reading and the current paper-processing lifecycle while adding, in releasable phases:

  • a persistent Read / You application shell and accessible launch motion;
  • Drift/SQLite for relational offline cache, drafts, and a durable sync outbox;
  • OIDC Authorization Code with PKCE, secure token storage, and provider-neutral backend verification (with Keycloak as the reference deployment);
  • synchronized To Read saves for signed-in users;
  • public, flat paper comments with terms acceptance, reporting, blocking, moderation, account deletion, and operational ownership;
  • PostgreSQL-backed shared rate limits, contract checks, observability, and production operations.

The canonical plan's stable API names, including names reserved by successful v0.0 semantics, are indexed in the API error catalogue.

Non-negotiable guardrails

The canonical plan's execution contract is binding. In particular:

  • do not rewrite the current paper pipeline or weaken its generation-scoped artifact and full-text-policy boundaries;
  • never initiate paper preparation through startup, prefetch, cache loading, or account synchronization; it remains a committed reader transition or explicit retry;
  • preserve anonymous browsing and reading; authentication is only for cloud-owned and moderation-sensitive actions;
  • do not store passwords or put access/refresh tokens in general preferences, SQLite, logs, analytics, crash reports, or provider snapshots;
  • make retried writes idempotent and use expand-and-contract database migrations;
  • do not expose public comments until all required safety controls are live;
  • do not add a network service without an ADR; PostgreSQL remains the shared synchronization, jobs, and rate-limit source of truth for this milestone.

Phase records

Phase 0 creates safe extension points without altering the visible demo. Its documentation outputs are this plan entrypoint and the ADRs in docs/adr/. The implementation outputs are route/middleware/DTO and repository splits, initial OpenAPI, typed flags, and validated staging/ production configuration. No accounts, account tables, or public controls are introduced by Phase 0 alone.

Implementation evidence is recorded in the Phase 0 report.

Phase 1 establishes the two-destination mobile frame, stateful routing, validated paper/arXiv links, guest You surface, root contextual routes, design tokens, light/dark themes, native launch assets, and a bounded cached-first startup state machine. Accounts, library, and comments remain explicitly disabled; their routes are truthful placeholders rather than partial product claims. Implementation and verification evidence is recorded in the Phase 1 report.

Phase 2 replaces bulk SharedPreferences content with a versioned Drift/SQLite database, transactionally imports and removes valid legacy blobs, and adds exact multi-page feed persistence, arXiv-version and processing-generation coherence, bounded eviction, and lifecycle-safe physical compaction. A dedicated feed-only prefetch coordinator implements single-flight cache-ahead, query obsolescence, retry/backoff, and content-free metrics. The backend and mobile client add opaque ETag/If-None-Match revalidation with bodyless 304 responses. The implementation is present; final integrated and native gates are recorded as passing in the Phase 2 report, and the phase is complete.

Phase 3 adds optional OIDC accounts while preserving guest reading. Its current implementation includes bounded provider-neutral discovery/JWKS verification, transactional JIT account mapping, versioned profile updates, the first shared PostgreSQL rate-limit bucket, native AppAuth and secure token storage, an optional Keycloak development profile, and the account-aware You/onboarding flow. GET and PATCH /v1/me are registered only when accounts are enabled; library, comments, and deletion remain absent. The repository-wide gates, native builds, live PostgreSQL scenarios, and real Keycloak/Mailpit PKCE flow passed, so Phase 3 is complete. Evidence is recorded in the Phase 3 report.

Phase 4 is complete. Its bounded contract is a single to_read set, authenticated list and account-scoped revision-change reads, idempotent save/remove writes, 90-day tombstones with a safe reset signal, and mobile optimistic outbox convergence. Another account's mutations never advance or leak through a reader's watermark. Library routes require the account and library gates; an independent write gate can freeze mutations without removing reads or affecting public paper access. The detailed contract is in To Read library synchronization, and the repository, live OIDC/PostgreSQL, two-client, no-preparation, write-kill, and native-build evidence is recorded in the Phase 4 report.

Phase 5 is complete as a repository capability. It implements flat public paper comments, current policy acceptance, deterministic and provider-neutral moderation, shared user/request-origin limits, separate comment-report, user-report, block, and author actions, audited moderator tooling, account-scoped mobile pages/drafts/blocks, and the independent comment-creation kill switch. Live two-user PostgreSQL/Keycloak and provider-outage evidence is recorded in the Phase 5 report. The feature remains default-off; public enablement also requires the target environment's moderation, deletion, legal, monitoring, and store-policy evidence.

Phase 6's repository implementation is present as a dark-launch release candidate. It includes the recent-auth mobile/API/web deletion flow, bounded Keycloak administration, leased deletion worker, independent signed restore ledger and replay, retention cleanup/purge controls, a production Helm topology, OTLP and a validating mobile telemetry gateway, a content-addressed production alert policy and immutable release-evidence contract bound to features, deployed image digests, chart/app identity, and legal-policy versions, exact- SHA scan-before-publish backend/site image automation with digest-only promotion, security/source/native SBOM workflows with reviewed runtime-graph completeness, and locked native/mobile release tools including MRI Ruby 3.4.10 and RubyGems 4.0.17 plus Flutter 3.44.8/framework 058e0af2c2b57e369d905a03ac9748b0ebf543c6/Dart 3.12.2, signed mobile candidate automation with content-addressed artifact/signing provenance, a protected four-device acceptance lane, policy/support hosting, and release, incident, moderation, deletion, observability, load, and backup/restore runbooks. The repository also contains an opt-in disposable Keycloak deletion acceptance workflow, a protected exact-SHA staging backend load gate, a manual exact-main public-edge verification/evidence lane for the configured dark deployment, and a closed two-phase restore harness bound to a protected attestation and content-addressed evidence. Mobile startup/cache/accessibility hardening covers one shared cache policy, stale-content-first rendering, an accessible cache-miss skeleton, shared paper actions, concurrent local/session work, retry/repair ownership, reduced motion, settled haptics, 200% text, contrast, and canonical arXiv actions. Repository and mobile evidence is recorded in the Phase 6 report and mobile Phase 6 report.

The 2026-08-02 closure audit also replaced readable pagination coordinates with rotation-aware authenticated-encryption tokens bound to each list's purpose and viewer/filter scope, bound feed validators to the active cursor-key epoch, made shared mobile connectivity state depend on raw transport outcomes, preserved real 401 reachability through failed refreshes, enforced one-shot authenticated handoffs, bounded safety-intent recovery after authenticated comment reload, hid comment totals until a network-backed page is known complete, and bound policy acceptance to the exact documents in each signed build. CI now parses every shell script independently rather than relying on Bash's multi-argument behavior, and the OpenAPI compatibility gate rejects directional schema, response, callback, webhook, and serialization regressions. At checkpoint d83ee84, the full canonical run passed Flutter analysis and all 610 then-locked tests, every Android debug flavor, every iOS simulator flavor, strict artifact inspection, the fresh-database Rust workspace, 31 browser/site tests, Helm, SBOM and release-contract validators, and the opt-in Collector export E2E. The locked suite includes account-rebind, deletion-latch, async-intent, and cache-purge isolation regressions. Subsequent current-tree mobile changes pass formatting, analysis, and all 49 tests in the six modified comment suites, but the expanded full Flutter suite has not been replayed. These are local repository checks; they do not alter the external release-gate status below. Fresh isolated reference-stack runs also passed the real Keycloak/PostgreSQL account-deletion worker/ledger/reconciliation path and the two-user plus operator comments/moderation/IdP-outage matrix, with redaction and cleanup.

Phase 6 is not accepted as a public/store release from source evidence alone. The disposable reference-provider workflow does not replace protected staging deletion against the real secret manager, external ledger, backup inventory, and alert route; the bounded load harness does not replace a successful protected staging run. The latest analyzer, locked-suite, debug/simulator artifact, site, Helm, and Collector results are current-tree local evidence. An actual isolated backup/PITR restore and deletion replay, migration/rollback exercise, deployed staging/production telemetry sink/retention and alert- adapter/receiver/canary checks, current networked advisory/container scans, protected image publication and digest promotion, a successful public-edge workflow artifact for that exact dark-deployed target, physical-device and performance/crash windows, protected signing, TestFlight/closed Play upload, reviewer account/notes, legal/content review, disclosures, and store approval remain external release gates and must stay marked unpassed until their owners attach immutable evidence.

Phase 0's exit criteria require unchanged demo behavior and API fixtures, passing ./scripts/check.sh, complete OpenAPI coverage for its existing routes, and no public account controls. Phase 2 additionally requires offline migration, the measured cache-ahead scenario, single-flight requests, enforced cache bounds, a saved-paper pin, and proof that prefetch does not prepare papers. Repository phases and public release gates are not considered complete merely because their code compiles: the acceptance scenarios and Definition of Done in the canonical plan remain the release gate.

Decision records

The following ADRs record the fixed choices needed before production behavior is added:

  1. ADR 0001 — OIDC and Keycloak reference deployment
  2. ADR 0002 — Drift local database
  3. ADR 0003 — Stateful shell routing
  4. ADR 0004 — Public comments and moderation
  5. ADR 0005 — Shared PostgreSQL rate limits
  6. ADR 0006 — Mobile telemetry gateway

状态： 权威实施计划与仓库状态入口 里程碑： Production v0.0 最后同步： 2026-08-09

本文档是 Production v0.0 计划的文档入口。完整的规范性计划维护在仓库根目录的 pakperk_production_v0_0_implementation_plan.md 中。特意将该文件设为规范版本，是为了让从仓库根目录工作的智能体与阅读 docs/ 的贡献者遵循同一套要求。修改任一位置时都必须维持这种关系；不得对规范计划中的要求作摘要、暗中缩小范围或选择性取代。

当前的仓库证据与发布证据状态维护在 Production v0.0 完成情况审计中。日常命令和发布顺序见开发者指南；面向读者的行为见用户指南。

计划的管辖范围

Production v0.0 将现有的模块化 Rust 单体服务与 Flutter 阅读器演进为可上架的早期产品。它保留访客阅读和当前的论文处理生命周期，同时按可发布阶段增加：

  • 持久化的 Read / You 应用外壳与无障碍启动动效；
  • 使用 Drift/SQLite 存储关系型离线缓存、草稿和持久化待同步队列（outbox）；
  • 采用 PKCE 的 OIDC Authorization Code、安全令牌存储，以及与身份提供商无关的后端验证（以 Keycloak 作为参考部署）；
  • 为已登录用户同步 To Read 收藏；
  • 公开、扁平的论文评论，以及条款接受、举报、屏蔽、内容审核、账户删除和运营责任；
  • 基于 PostgreSQL 的共享限流、契约检查、可观测性和生产运维。

规范计划中的稳定 API 名称（包括由成功的 v0.0 语义保留的名称）索引在 API 错误目录中。

不可妥协的护栏

规范计划的执行契约具有约束力。尤其要遵守以下要求：

  • 不得重写当前论文流水线，也不得削弱其限定处理代际的产物边界与全文策略边界；
  • 绝不能通过启动、预取、缓存加载或账户同步来触发论文准备；准备仍只能由用户确认进入阅读器或明确重试触发；
  • 保留匿名浏览和阅读；只有云端所有权操作及内容审核敏感操作才要求认证；
  • 不得存储密码，也不得把访问令牌/刷新令牌放入常规偏好、SQLite、日志、分析、崩溃报告或身份提供商快照；
  • 确保重试写入具备幂等性，并采用扩展后收缩式数据库迁移；
  • 在所有必需的安全控制上线前，不得开放公开评论；
  • 未撰写 ADR 不得新增网络服务；在此里程碑中，PostgreSQL 仍是共享同步、任务和速率限制的事实来源。

阶段记录

Phase 0 创建安全的扩展点，但不改变可见的演示行为。其文档产出是本计划入口和 docs/adr/ 中的 ADR。实施产出包括路由/中间件/DTO 与仓库层拆分、初始 OpenAPI、类型化功能标志，以及经过验证的预发布/生产配置。仅凭 Phase 0 不会引入账户、账户表或公开控件。

实施证据记录在 Phase 0 报告中。

Phase 1 建立双目的地移动端框架、保留状态的路由、经过验证的论文/arXiv 链接、访客 You 界面、根级上下文路由、设计令牌、浅色/深色主题、原生启动资源，以及有界且缓存优先的启动状态机。账户、Library 和评论仍明确处于禁用状态；相关路由是如实说明状态的占位页，而不是声称已交付一部分产品能力。实施与验证证据记录在 Phase 1 报告中。

Phase 2 使用带版本的 Drift/SQLite 数据库取代 SharedPreferences 中的批量内容，以事务方式导入并移除有效的旧版数据块，并增加确切的多页信息流持久化、arXiv 版本与处理代次一致性、有界淘汰和生命周期安全的物理压缩。专用且仅服务信息流的预取协调器实现合并并发请求的提前缓存、查询失效、重试/退避和不含内容的指标。后端和移动客户端新增不透明 ETag/If-None-Match 再验证，并以无正文的 304 响应。实施已经存在；最终集成门禁和原生门禁均在 Phase 2 报告中记录为通过，本阶段已完成。

Phase 3 在保留访客阅读的同时加入可选 OIDC 账户。当前实施包括有界且与身份提供商无关的发现/JWKS 验证、事务性 JIT 账户映射、带版本的资料更新、首个共享 PostgreSQL 速率限制桶、原生 AppAuth 与安全令牌存储，以及可选的 Keycloak 开发配置。它还实现了可感知账户状态的 You/引导流程。只有启用账户后才会注册 GET 和 PATCH /v1/me；Library、评论和删除功能仍不存在。仓库级门禁、原生构建、真实 PostgreSQL 场景和真实 Keycloak/Mailpit PKCE 流程均已通过，因此 Phase 3 已完成。证据记录在 Phase 3 报告中。

Phase 4 已完成。其有界契约包含单一 to_read 集合、已认证的列表与账户范围修订变更读取、幂等收藏/移除写入、保留 90 天且带安全重置信号的墓碑，以及移动端乐观待同步队列（outbox）收敛。其他账户的变更绝不会推进某位读者的水位线，也不会通过该水位线泄漏。Library 路由同时要求账户和 Library 门禁；独立写入门禁可以冻结变更操作，而不移除读取能力，也不影响公开论文访问。详细契约见 To Read Library 同步；仓库、真实 OIDC/PostgreSQL、双客户端、不触发准备、写入熔断和原生构建证据记录在 Phase 4 报告中。

Phase 5 作为仓库能力已完成。它实现了扁平的公开论文评论、当前策略接受、确定性且与身份提供商无关的内容审核、共享的用户/请求来源限制、独立的评论举报、用户举报、屏蔽和作者操作、经过审计的审核员管理工具、账户范围的移动端页面/草稿/屏蔽，以及独立的评论创建紧急关闭开关。真实双用户 PostgreSQL/Keycloak 和身份提供商故障证据记录在 Phase 5 报告中。该功能仍默认关闭；公开启用还要求目标环境提供内容审核、删除、法律、监控和应用商店策略证据。

Phase 6 的仓库实施已作为暗发布候选版本存在。它包括移动端/API/Web 近期认证删除流程、有界 Keycloak 管理、带租约的删除 worker、独立签名的恢复台账与重放、保留期清理/清除控件、生产 Helm 拓扑、OTLP 与具备验证能力的移动遥测网关、内容寻址的生产告警策略，以及绑定功能、已部署镜像摘要、Chart/应用身份和法律策略版本的不可变发布证据契约。它还包括先扫描再发布且绑定精确 SHA 的后端/站点镜像自动化与仅摘要晋升、安全/源码/原生 SBOM 工作流（附经审查的运行时依赖图完整性），以及锁定的原生/移动发布工具，包括 MRI Ruby 3.4.10、RubyGems 4.0.17、Flutter 3.44.8/framework 058e0af2c2b57e369d905a03ac9748b0ebf543c6/Dart 3.12.2。它还提供内容寻址的产物/签名溯源信息的签名移动候选版本自动化、受保护的四设备验收通道、策略/支持托管，以及发布、事件、内容审核、删除、可观测性、负载和备份/恢复运行手册。仓库还包含选择性启用的一次性 Keycloak 删除验收工作流、受保护且绑定精确 SHA 的预发布后端负载门禁、针对已配置暗发布部署的手动精确 main 公共边缘验证/证据通道，以及绑定受保护证明和内容寻址证据的闭合双阶段恢复工具。移动端启动/缓存/无障碍加固覆盖统一缓存策略、先显示陈旧内容、无障碍缓存未命中骨架屏、共享论文操作、并发本地/会话工作、重试/修复责任、减少动态效果、稳定后的触觉反馈、200% 文本、对比度和规范 arXiv 操作。仓库和移动端证据记录在 Phase 6 报告与移动端 Phase 6 报告中。

2026-08-02 的收口审计还用支持旋转的认证加密令牌取代了可读的分页坐标；这些令牌会绑定每个列表的用途以及查看者/筛选范围。该审计将信息流验证器绑定到活跃游标密钥纪元，让共享移动连接状态取决于原始传输结果，在刷新失败后仍保留真实 401 的可达性，强制一次性的认证交接，在已认证评论重新加载后提供有界的安全意图恢复，在确认已有网络支持的完整页面之前隐藏评论总数，并将策略接受绑定到每个签名构建中的确切文档。CI 现在会独立解析每个 shell 脚本，而不依赖 Bash 的多参数行为；OpenAPI 兼容性门禁会拒绝单向 schema、响应、回调、Webhook 和序列化回归。在检查点 d83ee84，完整规范运行通过了 Flutter 分析及当时锁定的全部 610 项测试、每个 Android 调试风味、每个 iOS 模拟器风味、严格产物检查、全新数据库 Rust 工作区、31 项浏览器/站点测试、Helm、SBOM 与发布契约验证器，以及选择性启用的 Collector 导出 E2E（端到端）测试。锁定套件包括账户重新绑定、删除锁存器、异步意图和缓存清除隔离回归。后续当前工作树的移动端变更通过了格式检查、分析和六个已修改评论套件中的全部 49 项测试，但尚未重放扩展后的完整 Flutter 套件。这些是本地仓库检查；它们不会改变下述外部发布门禁状态。全新隔离参考栈运行也通过了真实 Keycloak/PostgreSQL 账户删除 worker/台账/对账路径，以及双用户加操作员的评论/内容审核/IdP 故障矩阵，并完成脱敏和清理。

不能仅凭源代码证据将 Phase 6 接受为公开/商店发布。一次性参考身份提供商工作流不能替代针对真实秘密管理器、外部台账、备份清单和告警路由的受保护预发布删除验证；有界负载工具也不能替代一次成功的受保护预发布运行。最新的分析器、锁定套件、调试/模拟器产物、站点、Helm 和 Collector 结果都是当前工作树的本地证据。实际的隔离备份/PITR 恢复与删除重放、迁移/回滚演练、已部署预发布/生产遥测汇/保留期和告警适配器/接收器/金丝雀检查、当前联网的安全公告/容器扫描、受保护镜像发布与摘要晋升、对应确切暗发布目标的成功公共边缘工作流产物、实体设备与性能/崩溃窗口、受保护签名、TestFlight/Play 封闭测试上传、审核员账户/备注、法律/内容审查、信息披露和应用商店批准，仍是外部发布门禁；在负责人附上不可变证据前，必须一直将其标记为未通过。

Phase 0 的退出标准要求演示行为和 API 测试固件保持不变、./scripts/check.sh 通过、OpenAPI 完整覆盖现有路由，且不出现公开账户控件。Phase 2 还要求离线迁移、经测量的提前缓存场景、合并并发请求、强制缓存边界、已收藏论文固定项，以及预取不会准备论文的证明。不能只因代码可以编译就认定仓库阶段与公开发布门禁已完成：规范计划中的验收场景和完成定义仍是发布门禁。

决策记录

以下 ADR 记录了增加生产行为前所需的固定选择：

  1. ADR 0001 — OIDC 与 Keycloak 参考部署
  2. ADR 0002 — Drift 本地数据库
  3. ADR 0003 — 保留状态的应用外壳路由
  4. ADR 0004 — 公开评论与内容审核
  5. ADR 0005 — 共享 PostgreSQL 限流
  6. ADR 0006 — 移动遥测网关
